'''Vaal Venom Gyre''' is a [[claw]]/[[dagger]] [[attack]] [[active skill|skill]] that does not deal damage directly, but instead temporarily increases your maximum number of {{il|Venom Gyre}} caught Projectiles to 50, immediately grants you up to your maximum number of caught Projectiles on use, and grants additional caught Projectiles over a secondary duration.

==Skill functions and interactions==
{{:Venom Gyre#Skill functions and interactions}}
As this skill does not directly do damage, {{c|mod|#% increased Damage with Vaal Skills}} has no effect on damage.
